title: React Native & Android Developer
description:
Position: React Native & Android Developer

Company: Aookly

Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat

Job Type: Full-Time | On-Site

Experience: 1 Year

About the Role

Aookly is looking for a skilled React Native & Android Developer to develop, maintain, and improve mobile applications. The ideal candidate should have practical experience in mobile app development and a strong understanding of React Native and Android technologies.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain mobile applications using React Native and Android technologies.

- Build user-friendly and responsive mobile application interfaces.

- Integrate REST APIs and third-party services.

- Develop, test, and debug mobile applications.

- Identify and fix bugs and performance issues.

- Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and other team members.

- Optimize applications for better performance and usability.

- Assist with application deployment, updates, and maintenance.

- Ensure code quality and follow mobile development best practices.

Required Skills

- Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience in React Native and/or Android development.

- Good knowledge of JavaScript and React Native.

- Understanding of Android application development.

- Experience with REST API integration.

- Familiarity with Android Studio and Git.

- Basic knowledge of mobile app architecture and state management.

- Good problem-solving and debugging skills.

Preferred Skills

- Knowledge of Kotlin or Java for Android development.

- Experience with Firebase and push notifications.

- Familiarity with Redux or Context API.

- Experience publishing apps on the Google Play Store.

- Understanding of mobile app performance optimization.

Note: We are looking for candidates from Gujarat only.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at hr@aookly.com.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: React.js & React Native Developer
description:
We are looking for enthusiastic **React.js & React Native Developers** to join our growing team. Whether you are a fresher eager to start your career or an experienced developer looking for new challenges, we welcome candidates with strong fundamentals, a passion for development, and a willingness to learn.

Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain web applications using React.js.
* Build cross-platform mobile applications using React Native for Android and iOS.
* Create responsive, user-friendly web and mobile interfaces.
* Integrate REST APIs and third-party services.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and other team members.
* Debug, test, and optimize application performance.
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code.
* Fix bugs and support application updates and enhancements.
* Use Git for version control and team collaboration.

Skills Required

* Basic to good knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Knowledge of React.js and React Native.
* Understanding of components, props, state, and React Hooks.
* Understanding of responsive web design and mobile UI development.
* Familiarity with REST APIs and JSON.
* Basic knowledge of Git and GitHub.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.

Good to Have

* Experience with Redux, Context API, or other state management solutions.
* Experience or knowledge of Next.js
* Basic understanding of TypeScript.
* Familiarity with React Navigation.
* Experience with Android Studio, Xcode, or mobile app debugging.
* Knowledge of app builds, testing, and publishing to the Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
* Familiarity with UI libraries such as Material UI or Ant Design.

Who Can Apply?

* Freshers looking to start their software development career.
* Candidates with **0–1 year of experience**.
* Candidates with personal, academic, or professional React.js or React Native projects.
* Self-learners with practical development knowledge.
* Candidates with a B.Tech / B.E. (CE/IT), BCA, MCA, M.Tech (CE/IT), or M.Sc. (IT) background.
* Candidates with strong programming fundamentals and a willingness to learn.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on real-world web and mobile application projects.
* Mentorship and technical learning support.
* Career growth and skill development opportunities.
* Friendly and collaborative work environment.
* Hands-on experience with modern development technologies.

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Magento Frontend Developer
